acceptance_criteria: AC-E1: exactly one row 68 remains, it contains `THE LATENT CONDITION FIRED`, and the stale `It is inert **today** only because` phrase has zero hits. Expected `row=1 active=1 stale=0`; the positive row and active counts control the zero claim.

AC-E2: the nonempty fleet issue body contains the authoritative flag, exact plain-call form, AC-F1 through AC-F12, D-WORLD-DRIVER-1, and the sandbox warning. Deleting any one required label or the plain call makes the check red.
AC-E3: diff from base is empty under tools/launchd, pin-root.sh remains absent in World, the charter is changed, the issue body is nonempty, and scoped status contains exactly two paths.
AC-E4: both hand-off artifacts contain a known-positive subject marker and contain zero forbidden placeholders.
AC-E5: sprint JSON parses and sprint plan is nonempty; no product-gate result is attributed to the documentation milestone.
features.notes: Executor runs only repo-local static checks. External-path repeats are UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX and cannot accept the milestone.

features.name: Controller-only rig opt-out and fresh-fire proof
features.description: Outside the executor sandbox, preserve a named pre-edit backup, add exactly one AILANG_DRIVER_PIN=0 line idempotently, prove sourcing and helper behavior, then prove a new controller fire starts in the World repository and sees its charter.
dependencies: controller running outside codex workspace-write sandbox
acceptance_criteria: AC-C1: exact active opt-out count is 1 and the named pre-edit backup exists. Base is genuinely red at count 0.
AC-C2: re-running the exact edit block leaves the env-file SHA-256 unchanged.
AC-C3: sourcing the actual env file with the plist World path yields exactly `PIN=0 WD=/Users/voightkampff/dev/sunholo-data/ailang-world`.

AC-C4: after sourcing the actual env file, the real fleet helper returns to the caller with exactly `PIN_STATUS=disabled WD=/Users/voightkampff/dev/sunholo-data/ailang-world`; the precondition refuses before helper invocation if the line is missing.
AC-C5: the count of the pin-disabled marker in the live World log is strictly greater after the next fire than the count captured before the edit.
AC-C6: inside the newly fired controller before sprint-worktree creation, pwd is the real World clone, origin is sunholo-data/ailang-world, and design_docs/world-mission.md exists.
features.notes: Only controller evidence outside sandbox counts. Calendar completion waits for a new scheduled fire.

executor_constraints.git_writes: FORBIDDEN. No add, commit, checkout, stash, branch, restore, reset, or worktree operations. The controller commits.
files_forbidden: any launchd plist, service, socket, process, or live controller state
executor_constraints.external_effects: The executor does not edit the rig env and does not file the GitHub issue. Both are controller actions.
executor_constraints.frozen_core: D-WORLD-DRIVER-1 is binding. World never edits tools/launchd/*. M2 is fleet-owned.
executor_constraints.gate_3b: Expect inherited failures in `go host build + test gate` and `launchd drivers (bash 3.2)` due to deleted tools/launchd paths. Do not fix or mask them.

sandbox_posture: The executor's only authoritative verdicts are static checks over its two repo-local hand-off artifacts. Any executor result involving external clones, the rig env, launchd, sockets, the live log, or a live controller is UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX. Controller AC-C1 through AC-C6 run outside sandbox and are never attributed to the executor.
